what_happened: Confirmed via direct read and a validated bash scratch harness that both is_contained_v10 (git-commit-scoped.sh) and its ported twin is_contained (git-commit-phase.sh) fail to match /**-suffixed file_scope entries because the entry variable is quoted inside the case pattern, disabling its own glob interpretation. A minimal added branch (parameter-expansion suffix-strip of a literal /** then ordinary prefix test) fixes both sites without widening non-glob entries; validated against 9 cases including same-prefix-sibling negatives. Task 425 confirmed independent (different site/language/root-cause, no shared helper, no file_scope overlap) -- no dependency edge needed.
